children: Analog will acquire Alif Semiconductor in an all-cash transaction for $1.35 billion, with up to $200 million contingent consideration.
Announced definitive agreement to acquire Alif, a provider of low-power AI/ML microcontrollers and fusion processors.
Purchase price: $1.35 billion upfront in cash; up to $200 million additional contingent consideration.
Transaction expected to close in Q4 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and HSR waiting period.
Deal aims to combine Alif’s AI-native processors with Analog’s analog and sensing portfolio to expand addressable markets.
